description: Image Description: The image depicts a close-up view of a parking meter on a street. The parking meter is an older, mechanical style with a dial showing "0:00," indicating that no time is currently paid for. The meter is mounted on a post and has a semi-circular face. The background is blurred, featuring indistinct shapes and colors that suggest an urban setting with possibly more meters or street signs. The focus is primarily on the parking meter, highlighting its details and condition.
